description: Sierra Leone: 4,000 displacements, 31 August - 05 September. According to IFRC, over 4000 people were displaced due to flood between 31 August and 05 September 2025 in Bonthe, Kenema, Bo, Moyamba, Kono, Falaba and Koinadugu Districts. International Federation of the Red Cross (IFRC) - 22 September 2025
